source: Proposal by the package author (Claude Code, 2026-11-27). Not approved; only Thomas approves a mapping.

rows.reason: The approved mapping of franzoesisch-gymnasium-7 (2026-11-23) already moves this history to f7-1-imparfait-check. One history never moves twice, and second-language learners meet the imparfait in Grade 7, not in this package.

The composite asks for imparfait formation, the imparfait and passé composé contrast and one fixed translation. Grade 8 revises the past tenses around the plus-que-parfait; no card here keeps the whole prompt. Whether a dedicated B successor belongs in this package is an open question for Thomas.
Adverbial y is Grade 9 content for French as the second foreign language (LehrplanPLUS F9: pronoms adverbiaux « y » / « en »). This package teaches no y.

The composite combines object pronouns with y, en and the futur simple; the futur simple and the adverbial pronouns are Grade 9 content for the second foreign language, so no Grade 8 card is equivalent.
